title: Footprints Ahead
status: concept-proposal (Creative Director, 2026-11-19; not approved; awaiting owner review)
hook_line: Footprints appeared in the snow ahead of me.
first_visual: An untouched snowy path under a streetlamp; one footprint presses itself in, nobody there.

beats.visual: Snowy path; a footprint presses itself into the snow, then another.
beats.vo: Footprints appeared in the snow ahead of me.

beats.visual: Ivy in the blizzard follows the prints, which steer around an icy drain.
beats.vo: Whiteout. Couldn't see the kerb. They kept me off the ice.

beats.visual: At the building door the prints stop; Ivy smiles.
beats.vo: I said thank you. To nobody.

beats.visual: Close on the last print: the toes point at her.
beats.vo: Then I saw which way the toes pointed.

beats.visual: Pull back down the lane: every print faces her.
beats.vo: All the way home. Backwards. Watching me.

beats.visual: Key moment: new prints stamp toward her fast, forwards now; cut to black on the last crunch.

ending: New prints begin, forwards this time, coming at her fast. Cut to black on a crunch.
loop_note: Partial. The final rush of prints mirrors the first print appearing.

originality_review: Original. This uses the snow-footprint image but inverts it: the helper faces you. It avoids the 'tracks with no return' and skinwalker tropes. Seasonal fit (G3).
scores_basis: Initial editorial judgement, 2026-11-19. topic_demand is an estimate linked to research/WEEKLY_TREND_REPORT.md categories, not a measurement of this concept.
concept: In a whiteout, invisible footprints lead Ivy safely home. At her door she realises the toes all point toward her. It walked backwards the whole way, facing her.

hooks.line: Footprints appeared in the snow ahead of me.
hooks.first_visual: An untouched snowy path under a streetlamp; one footprint presses itself in, nobody there.

hooks.line: Invisible footprints walked me home. I said thank you.
hooks.first_visual: A woman smiling at an empty path.

hooks.line: Look which way the toes were pointing.
hooks.first_visual: Close-up: a bare footprint in snow, toes facing camera.

hooks.line: It walked me home. Backwards. Watching me.
hooks.first_visual: A long line of prints all facing toward the viewer.

hooks.line: Who was leading me through the blizzard?
hooks.first_visual: Heavy snow, a single line of fresh prints.

setting: Winter Lane in a blizzard; streetlamp cones; kerb and an iced drain.
conflict: Ivy cannot see the road and has to trust the prints.
escalation: The prints steer her past ice and a drain, right to her door.
reveal: The heel and toe orientation: every print faces her.
